verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the founder's description of Zero as an email client that 'auto-categorizes' mail. That is the product's own categorization capability, but nothing shows it splits the inbox into separate triage streams such as important, team, newsletters, or calendar invites. The MCP label tools (create labels, filter by labels) are adjacent building blocks rather than a split-inbox feature, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented split-inbox or focused-stream views, the specific stream categories (important/team/newsletters/calendar invites), priority-ordered triage workflow, first-party docs for auto-categorization, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order

citations.quote: Zero founder describes it as an AI-powered email client that auto-categorizes, summarizes threads, drafts replies, and lets users chat with their inbox
